content: शमन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [शम् णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Quelling, allaying, subduing <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-नम्@} .²1 Appeasing, allaying, soothing, conquering, alleviating, <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Calmness, tranquillity. .²3 End, stop, cessation, destruction. .²4 Hurting, injuring; destroying; सपत्नशमनम् <ls>Mb. 3. 85. 101</ls>. .²5 Killing animals for sacrifice, immolation. .²6 Swallowing, chewing. .{@-नः@} .²1 A kind of deer, an antelope. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Yama, the god of death; शतशस्तत्र यवनाः शमनातिथयोऽभवन् <ls>Śiva B. 14. 94</ls>. .²3 A kind of pea.
